### Modelos regionais

```{r}
library(glmnet)

run_regional_lasso <- function(full_survey_obj) {
  
  # Extract the flat data frame ONCE
  full_df <- full_survey_obj$variables
  
  # Define the regions
  regions <- c("Norte", "Nordeste", "Sudeste", "Sul", "Centro-Oeste")
  
  # Create a list to store the full cv.glmnet model objects
  lasso_models <- list()
  
  for (reg in regions) {
    cat(sprintf("Processing region: %s...\n", reg))
    
    # Isolate the specific macroregion
    temp_df <- subset(full_df, macroregion == reg)
    
    # Prepare the matrices and vectors
    lasso_data <- prepare_lasso_data(temp_df)
    
    # Run the LASSO
    cv_lasso <- cv.glmnet(
      x = lasso_data$X_matrix,
      y = lasso_data$Y,
      family = "multinomial",
      weights = lasso_data$weights
    )
    
    # SAVE THE FULL MODEL OBJECT instead of just the coefficients
    lasso_models[[reg]] <- cv_lasso
    
    # RAM Cleanup: Destroy the heavy data matrices but keep the model
    rm(temp_df, lasso_data, cv_lasso)
    gc()
  }
  
  cat("All regional LASSO models adjusted successfully!\n")
  return(lasso_models)
}
```

```{r}
# Run the pipeline (this stores the full models)
regional_models <- run_regional_lasso(pnadc)

# 1. Generate the cross-validation plot for a specific region
plot(regional_models[["Nordeste"]])

# 2. Extract the coefficients for a specific region
nordeste_coefficients <- coef(regional_models[["Nordeste"]], s = "lambda.min")
print(nordeste_coefficients)
```
